tasks.goal: Normalize a direction without dividing by zero
tasks.prompt: Write a pure Luau module returning the requested function. Use only numbers, plain tables and the standard library; no Roblox engine objects, services, global state, clock or global RNG. Inputs are finite numbers of moderate magnitude unless an invalid-input case is specified. Do not mutate input tables. Return normalize(v) for {x,y,z}; return nil when its magnitude is <= 1e-12, otherwise return a fresh unit vector. Numerical answers use absolute tolerance 1e-9 and relative tolerance 0; booleans, nil, indices and integer states are exact.

unit_test.body:
local f = load_answer()
local function near(a, b)
    return type(a) == "number" and math.abs(a - b) <= 1e-9
end
local function vnear(a, b)
    return type(a) == "table" and near(a.x, b.x) and near(a.y, b.y) and near(a.z, b.z)
end
check("returns a function", type(f) == "function")
check("zero has no direction", f({x=0,y=0,z=0}) == nil)
check("tiny has no direction", f({x=1e-13,y=0,z=0}) == nil)
check("threshold is inclusive", f({x=1e-12,y=0,z=0}) == nil)
check("small nonzero survives", vnear(f({x=1e-10,y=0,z=0}), {x=1,y=0,z=0}))
check("three four normalizes", vnear(f({x=3,y=4,z=0}), {x=0.6,y=0.8,z=0}))
check("signs survive", vnear(f({x=0,y=-3,z=4}), {x=0,y=-0.6,z=0.8}))
local p = {x=2,y=-2,z=1}
local q = f(p)
check("fresh result and no input mutation", q ~= p and p.x == 2 and p.y == -2 and p.z == 1)
check("unit magnitude", near(q.x*q.x+q.y*q.y+q.z*q.z, 1))

tasks.reference_answer:
local function normalize(v)
    local m = math.sqrt(v.x*v.x + v.y*v.y + v.z*v.z)
    if m <= 1e-12 then return nil end
    return {x=v.x/m, y=v.y/m, z=v.z/m}
end
return normalize
tasks.bad_answer:
local function normalize(v)
    local m = v.x*v.x + v.y*v.y + v.z*v.z
    if m <= 1e-12 then return nil end
    return {x=v.x/m, y=v.y/m, z=v.z/m}
end
return normalize
tasks.bad_answer_reason: Divides by squared length instead of length.

tasks.goal: Test whether a target lies in a facing cone
tasks.prompt: Write a pure Luau module returning the requested function. Use only numbers, plain tables and the standard library; no Roblox engine objects, services, global state, clock or global RNG. Inputs are finite numbers of moderate magnitude unless an invalid-input case is specified. Do not mutate input tables. Return inCone(forward, offset, halfAngle) for {x,y,z} vectors and halfAngle in [0,pi]. A zero offset is inside; otherwise a zero forward is outside. Test the normalized dot product >= cos(halfAngle), including the boundary. Numerical answers use absolute tolerance 1e-9 and relative tolerance 0; booleans, nil, indices and integer states are exact.

unit_test.body:
local f = load_answer()
local function near(a, b)
    return type(a) == "number" and math.abs(a - b) <= 1e-9
end
check("returns a function", type(f) == "function")
local x = {x=1,y=0,z=0}
check("ahead is inside", f(x, {x=2,y=0,z=0}, 0.2) == true)
check("behind is outside", f(x, {x=-2,y=0,z=0}, 0.2) == false)
check("side is outside narrow cone", f(x, {x=0,y=5,z=0}, math.pi/3) == false)
check("normalizes both vectors", f({x=10,y=0,z=0}, {x=1,y=3,z=0}, math.pi/4) == false)
check("zero offset is inside", f(x, {x=0,y=0,z=0}, 0) == true)
check("zero forward is outside", f({x=0,y=0,z=0}, x, 1) == false)
check("zero width includes forward", f(x, x, 0) == true)
check("full cone includes backward", f(x, {x=-1,y=0,z=0}, math.pi) == true)
check("input remains unchanged", x.x == 1 and x.y == 0 and x.z == 0)

tasks.reference_answer:
local function inCone(forward, offset, halfAngle)
    local a = forward.x^2 + forward.y^2 + forward.z^2
    local b = offset.x^2 + offset.y^2 + offset.z^2
    if b == 0 then return true end
    if a == 0 then return false end
    local dot = forward.x*offset.x + forward.y*offset.y + forward.z*offset.z
    return dot / math.sqrt(a*b) >= math.cos(halfAngle)
end
return inCone
tasks.bad_answer:

    local a = forward.x^2 + forward.y^2 + forward.z^2
    local b = offset.x^2 + offset.y^2 + offset.z^2
    if b == 0 then return true end
    if a == 0 then return false end
    local dot = forward.x*offset.x + forward.y*offset.y + forward.z*offset.z
    return dot >= math.cos(halfAngle)
end
return inCone
tasks.bad_answer_reason: Uses a raw dot product, making the cone depend on vector lengths.

tasks.goal: Compose two rigid coordinate frames in the right order
tasks.prompt: Write a pure Luau module returning the requested function. Use only numbers, plain tables and the standard library; no Roblox engine objects, services, global state, clock or global RNG. Inputs are finite numbers of moderate magnitude unless an invalid-input case is specified. Do not mutate input tables. Return compose(a,b) representing a*b. Each frame is {p={x,y,z}, r={r11,r12,r13,r21,r22,r23,r31,r32,r33}} with a row-major orthonormal rotation. For column vectors, pOut=a.p+a.r*b.p and rOut=a.r*b.r. Return fresh p and r tables. Numerical answers use absolute tolerance 1e-9 and relative tolerance 0; booleans, nil, indices and integer states are exact.

unit_test.body:
local f = load_answer()
local function near(a, b)
    return type(a) == "number" and math.abs(a - b) <= 1e-9
end
local function vnear(a, b)
    return type(a) == "table" and near(a.x, b.x) and near(a.y, b.y) and near(a.z, b.z)
end
check("returns a function", type(f) == "function")
local I = {p={x=0,y=0,z=0},r={1,0,0,0,1,0,0,0,1}}
local A = {p={x=10,y=20,z=30},r={0,-1,0,1,0,0,0,0,1}}
local B = {p={x=2,y=3,z=4},r={1,0,0,0,0,-1,0,1,0}}
local C = f(A,B)
check("translation is rotated by parent", vnear(C.p,{x=7,y=22,z=34}))
local expected, rotationOK = {0,0,1,1,0,0,0,1,0}, true
for i=1,9 do rotationOK = rotationOK and near(C.r[i],expected[i]) end
check("rotation uses ordered matrix product", rotationOK)
check("left identity", vnear(f(I,A).p,A.p))
check("right identity", vnear(f(A,I).p,A.p))
check("composition is not commutative", not vnear(f(B,A).p,C.p))
check("fresh nested tables", C ~= A and C ~= B and C.p ~= A.p and C.p ~= B.p and C.r ~= A.r and C.r ~= B.r)
check("inputs unchanged", A.p.x == 10 and A.r[2] == -1 and B.p.y == 3 and B.r[6] == -1)

tasks.reference_answer:
local function compose(a, b)
    local r = {}
    for i=0,2 do
        for j=1,3 do
            local s = 0
            for k=1,3 do s = s + a.r[i*3+k]*b.r[(k-1)*3+j] end
            r[i*3+j] = s
        end
    end
    local p = b.p
    return {p={x=a.p.x+a.r[1]*p.x+a.r[2]*p.y+a.r[3]*p.z,
        y=a.p.y+a.r[4]*p.x+a.r[5]*p.y+a.r[6]*p.z,
        z=a.p.z+a.r[7]*p.x+a.r[8]*p.y+a.r[9]*p.z}, r=r}
end
return compose

tasks.goal: Construct a stable look-at basis with Roblox forward convention
tasks.prompt: Write a pure Luau module returning the requested function. Use only numbers, plain tables and the standard library; no Roblox engine objects, services, global state, clock or global RNG. Inputs are finite numbers of moderate magnitude unless an invalid-input case is specified. Do not mutate input tables. Return lookAt(eye,target,up) as {p=eye copy, right={x,y,z}, up={x,y,z}, back={x,y,z}}. Local -Z faces target, so back=unit(eye-target), right=unit(up cross back), correctedUp=back cross right. Return nil for eye==target (distance <=1e-12). Normalize up before testing it. For zero up or |unitUp cross back| <=1e-6, use world Y if abs(back.y)<0.999, otherwise world X. Numerical answers use absolute tolerance 1e-9 and relative tolerance 0; booleans, nil, indices and integer states are exact.

unit_test.body:
local f = load_answer()
local function near(a, b)
    return type(a) == "number" and math.abs(a - b) <= 1e-9
end
local function vnear(a, b)
    return type(a) == "table" and near(a.x, b.x) and near(a.y, b.y) and near(a.z, b.z)
end
check("returns a function", type(f) == "function")
local O, Y = {x=0,y=0,z=0}, {x=0,y=1,z=0}
local c = f(O,{x=0,y=0,z=-5},Y)
check("minus Z is forward", vnear(c.back,{x=0,y=0,z=1}))
check("canonical right and up", vnear(c.right,{x=1,y=0,z=0}) and vnear(c.up,Y))
local side = f({x=2,y=3,z=4},{x=9,y=3,z=4},{x=0,y=7,z=0})
check("looks toward positive X", vnear(side.back,{x=-1,y=0,z=0}) and vnear(side.right,{x=0,y=0,z=1}))
check("coincident target", f(O,O,Y) == nil)
local vertical = f(O,Y,Y)
check("parallel up has deterministic fallback", vnear(vertical.right,{x=0,y=0,z=-1}) and vnear(vertical.up,{x=1,y=0,z=0}))
local zeroUp = f(O,{x=0,y=0,z=-2},O)
check("zero up has fallback", vnear(zeroUp.right,{x=1,y=0,z=0}))
local tilted = f(O,{x=1,y=2,z=3},{x=1,y=9,z=1})
local function dot(a,b) return a.x*b.x+a.y*b.y+a.z*b.z end
check("orthonormal basis", near(dot(tilted.right,tilted.up),0) and near(dot(tilted.up,tilted.back),0) and near(dot(tilted.back,tilted.right),0) and near(dot(tilted.right,tilted.right),1) and near(dot(tilted.up,tilted.up),1) and near(dot(tilted.back,tilted.back),1))
check("fresh position and unchanged inputs", c.p ~= O and vnear(c.p,O) and Y.y == 1)

tasks.reference_answer:
local function cross(a,b)
    return {x=a.y*b.z-a.z*b.y,y=a.z*b.x-a.x*b.z,z=a.x*b.y-a.y*b.x}
end
local function unit(v)
    local m = math.sqrt(v.x^2+v.y^2+v.z^2)
    if m <= 1e-12 then return nil end
    return {x=v.x/m,y=v.y/m,z=v.z/m}
end
local function lookAt(eye,target,up)
    local back = unit({x=eye.x-target.x,y=eye.y-target.y,z=eye.z-target.z})
    if not back then return nil end
    local u = unit(up)
    local right = u and cross(u,back) or {x=0,y=0,z=0}
    if right.x^2+right.y^2+right.z^2 <= 1e-12 then
        if math.abs(back.y) < 0.999 then u={x=0,y=1,z=0} else u={x=1,y=0,z=0} end
        right = cross(u,back)
    end
    right = unit(right)
    return {p={x=eye.x,y=eye.y,z=eye.z},right=right,up=cross(back,right),back=back}
end
return lookAt

end

Inputs are finite numbers of moderate magnitude unless an invalid-input case is specified. Do not mutate input tables. Return lerp(a,b,t)=a+(b-a)*t. Do not clamp t; values outside [0,1] extrapolate. Return exact a and b at t=0 and t=1. Numerical answers use absolute tolerance 1e-9 and relative tolerance 0; booleans, nil, indices and integer states are exact.

local function near(a, b)
    return type(a) == "number" and math.abs(a - b) <= 1e-9
end
check("returns a function", type(f) == "function")
check("start endpoint", f(10,20,0) == 10)
check("end endpoint", f(10,20,1) == 20)
check("quarter point", near(f(10,20,0.25),12.5))

local function lerp(a,b,t)
    if t == 0 then return a end
    if t == 1 then return b end
    return a+(b-a)*t
end
return lerp

tasks.goal: Implement power easing families with direction
tasks.prompt: Write a pure Luau module returning the requested function. Use only numbers, plain tables and the standard library; no Roblox engine objects, services, global state, clock or global RNG. Inputs are finite numbers of moderate magnitude unless an invalid-input case is specified. Do not mutate input tables. Return ease(t,power,direction) with power an integer 2..5 and direction "in", "out" or "inOut"; raise errors for other powers/directions. Clamp t to [0,1]. In=t^power, Out=1-(1-t)^power, InOut uses half of In(2*t) on the first half and 1-half*In(2*(1-t)) on the second. Numerical answers use absolute tolerance 1e-9 and relative tolerance 0; booleans, nil, indices and integer states are exact.

unit_test.body:
local f = load_answer()
local function near(a, b)
    return type(a) == "number" and math.abs(a - b) <= 1e-9
end
check("returns a function", type(f) == "function")
check("quadratic in", near(f(0.5,2,"in"),0.25))
check("cubic out", near(f(0.5,3,"out"),0.875))
check("quartic inOut first half", near(f(0.25,4,"inOut"),0.03125))
check("quintic inOut second half", near(f(0.75,5,"inOut"),0.984375))
local endpoints = true
for p=2,5 do
    for _,d in ipairs({"in","out","inOut"}) do
        endpoints = endpoints and near(f(-2,p,d),0) and near(f(3,p,d),1)
    end
end
check("all families clamp endpoints", endpoints)
check("midpoint is continuous", near(f(0.5,5,"inOut"),0.5))
check("invalid power rejected", not pcall(f,0.5,1,"in") and not pcall(f,0.5,2.5,"in"))
check("invalid direction rejected", not pcall(f,0.5,2,"sideways"))

tasks.reference_answer:
local function ease(t,power,direction)
    assert(power >= 2 and power <= 5 and power == math.floor(power), "power")
    assert(direction == "in" or direction == "out" or direction == "inOut", "direction")
    t=math.max(0,math.min(1,t))
    if direction == "in" then return t^power end
    if direction == "out" then return 1-(1-t)^power end
    if t < 0.5 then return (2*t)^power/2 end
    return 1-(2*(1-t))^power/2
end
return ease

tasks.goal: Implement sine and exponential easing
tasks.prompt: Write a pure Luau module returning the requested function. Use only numbers, plain tables and the standard library; no Roblox engine objects, services, global state, clock or global RNG. Inputs are finite numbers of moderate magnitude unless an invalid-input case is specified. Do not mutate input tables. Return ease(t,family,direction), with family "sine" or "expo" and direction "in", "out", "inOut"; reject unknown values. Clamp input t. Define InSine(t)=1-cos(pi*t/2). Define InExpo(t)=2^(10*(t-1)), with exact endpoints 0 and 1 for every function. Out(t)=1-In(1-t); InOut(t)=In(2*t)/2 below 0.5 and 1-In(2*(1-t))/2 otherwise. Numerical answers use absolute tolerance 1e-9 and relative tolerance 0; booleans, nil, indices and integer states are exact.

unit_test.body:
local f = load_answer()
local function near(a, b)
    return type(a) == "number" and math.abs(a - b) <= 1e-9
end
check("returns a function", type(f) == "function")
check("sine in midpoint", near(f(0.5,"sine","in"),1-math.sqrt(0.5)))
check("sine out midpoint", near(f(0.5,"sine","out"),math.sqrt(0.5)))
check("sine inOut quarter", near(f(0.25,"sine","inOut"),(1-math.sqrt(0.5))/2))
check("expo in midpoint", near(f(0.5,"expo","in"),0.03125))
check("expo out midpoint", near(f(0.5,"expo","out"),0.96875))
check("expo inOut second half", near(f(0.75,"expo","inOut"),0.984375))
local exact = true
for _,family in ipairs({"sine","expo"}) do
    for _,d in ipairs({"in","out","inOut"}) do
        exact = exact and f(-1,family,d) == 0 and f(2,family,d) == 1
    end
end
check("exact clamped endpoints", exact)
check("unknown family rejected", not pcall(f,0.5,"unknown","in"))
check("unknown direction rejected", not pcall(f,0.5,"sine","sideways"))

tasks.reference_answer:
local function ease(t,family,direction)
    assert(family == "sine" or family == "expo", "family")
    assert(direction == "in" or direction == "out" or direction == "inOut", "direction")
    t=math.max(0,math.min(1,t))
    if t == 0 or t == 1 then return t end
    local function inward(x)
        if family == "sine" then return 1-math.cos(math.pi*x/2) end
        return 2^(10*(x-1))
    end
    if direction == "in" then return inward(t) end
    if direction == "out" then return 1-inward(1-t) end
    if t < 0.5 then return inward(2*t)/2 end
    return 1-inward(2*(1-t))/2
end
return ease
tasks.bad_answer:
local function ease(t,family,direction)
    assert(family == "sine" or family == "expo", "family")
    assert(direction == "in" or direction == "out" or direction == "inOut", "direction")
    t=math.max(0,math.min(1,t))
    -- Incorrectly omits exact endpoint handling.
    local function inward(x)
        if family == "sine" then return 1-math.cos(math.pi*x/2) end
        return 2^(10*(x-1))
    end
    if direction == "in" then return inward(t) end
    if direction == "out" then return 1-inward(1-t) end
    if t < 0.5 then return inward(2*t)/2 end
    return 1-inward(2*(1-t))/2
end
return ease

Inputs are finite numbers of moderate magnitude unless an invalid-input case is specified. Do not mutate input tables. Return spring(x,v,target,omega,dt) -> newX,newV for constant target, omega>=0 (radians/second) and dt>=0. Solve x''+2*omega*x'+omega^2*(x-target)=0 exactly over dt. omega=0 means free motion x+v*dt. Reject negative omega or dt; do not clamp velocity or overshoot. Numerical answers use absolute tolerance 1e-9 and relative tolerance 0; booleans, nil, indices and integer states are exact.

unit_test.body:
local f = load_answer()
local function near(a, b)
    return type(a) == "number" and math.abs(a - b) <= 1e-9
end
check("returns a function", type(f) == "function")
local x,v = f(10,0,0,2,0.5)
check("analytical displacement", near(x,20/math.exp(1)))
check("analytical velocity", near(v,-20/math.exp(1)))
local a,b = f(3,-4,1,2,0)
check("zero dt preserves state", a == 3 and b == -4)
a,b = f(3,-4,99,0,0.5)
check("zero frequency is free motion", near(a,1) and near(b,-4))
local h1,hv1 = f(3,-4,1,2,0.125)
local h2,hv2 = f(h1,hv1,1,2,0.375)
local whole,wv = f(3,-4,1,2,0.5)
check("time partition invariance", near(h2,whole) and near(hv2,wv))
a,b = f(7,0,7,4,3)
check("equilibrium stays still", near(a,7) and near(b,0))
a,b = f(10,0,0,2,100)
check("long step remains stable", near(a,0) and near(b,0))
check("negative time rejected", not pcall(f,1,0,0,2,-1))
check("negative frequency rejected", not pcall(f,1,0,0,-2,1))

tasks.reference_answer:
local function spring(x,v,target,omega,dt)
    assert(omega >= 0 and dt >= 0, "nonnegative omega and dt")
    local y=x-target
    local j=v+omega*y
    local e=math.exp(-omega*dt)
    return target+(y+j*dt)*e, (v-omega*j*dt)*e
end
return spring

Zero direction/normal or abs(dot(direction,normal))<=1e-12*|direction|*|normal| is parallel and yields nil. Reject intersections behind the origin or beyond maxT. end

local function dot(a,b) return a.x*b.x+a.y*b.y+a.z*b.z end
local function rayPlane(o,d,p,n,maxT)
    assert(maxT >= 0, "maxT")
    local denom=dot(d,n)
    if math.abs(denom) <= 1e-12*math.sqrt(dot(d,d)*dot(n,n)) then return nil end

    local t=dot(delta,n)/denom
    if t < 0 or t > maxT then return nil end
    return t,{x=o.x+t*d.x,y=o.y+t*d.y,z=o.z+t*d.z}
end
return rayPlane

tasks.reference_answer:
local function dot(a,b) return a.x*b.x+a.y*b.y+a.z*b.z end
local function raySphere(o,d,center,radius)
    assert(radius >= 0, "radius")
    local a=dot(d,d)
    if a == 0 then return nil end
    local m={x=o.x-center.x,y=o.y-center.y,z=o.z-center.z}
    local b=dot(m,d)
    local c=dot(m,m)-radius*radius
    local disc=b*b-a*c
    if disc < 0 then return nil end
    local root=math.sqrt(disc)
    local first=(-b-root)/a
    if first >= 0 then return first end
    local last=(-b+root)/a
    if last >= 0 then return last end
    return nil
end
return raySphere

tasks.goal: Select a weighted bucket deterministically
tasks.prompt: Write a pure Luau module returning the requested function. Use only numbers, plain tables and the standard library; no Roblox engine objects, services, global state, clock or global RNG. Inputs are finite numbers of moderate magnitude unless an invalid-input case is specified. Do not mutate input tables. Return choose(weights,u) as a 1-based index. weights is a nonempty dense array of finite nonnegative numbers with finite positive total; u is finite and 0<=u<1. Reject invalid weights, total or u. Choose the first cumulative total strictly greater than u*total, so zero weights never win and exact boundaries go to the next positive bucket. Use the last positive bucket as a rounding fallback only. Numerical answers use absolute tolerance 1e-9 and relative tolerance 0; booleans, nil, indices and integer states are exact.

unit_test.body:
local f = load_answer()
local function near(a, b)
    return type(a) == "number" and math.abs(a - b) <= 1e-9
end
check("returns a function", type(f) == "function")
local w={0,1,0,3,0}
check("leading zero never wins", f(w,0) == 2)
check("first bucket interior", f(w,0.249) == 2)
check("exact boundary advances", f(w,0.25) == 4)
check("last positive bucket", f(w,0.999999) == 4)
check("scaling preserves buckets", f({0,10,0,30,0},0.25) == 4)
check("empty and zero totals rejected", not pcall(f,{},0) and not pcall(f,{0,0},0))
check("negative weight rejected", not pcall(f,{1,-1,3},0.5))
check("nonfinite weights rejected", not pcall(f,{0/0},0) and not pcall(f,{math.huge},0))
check("overflow total rejected", not pcall(f,{1e308,1e308},0))
check("invalid draws rejected", not pcall(f,{1},-0.1) and not pcall(f,{1},1) and not pcall(f,{1},0/0))
check("inputs unchanged", w[1] == 0 and w[2] == 1 and w[4] == 3 and #w == 5)

tasks.reference_answer:
local function choose(weights,u)
    assert(type(u) == "number" and u >= 0 and u < 1, "u")
    local total,last=0,nil
    for i,w in ipairs(weights) do
        assert(type(w) == "number" and w >= 0 and w < math.huge, "weight")
        total=total+w
        if w > 0 then last=i end
    end
    assert(total > 0 and total < math.huge, "total")
    local target,sum=u*total,0
    for i,w in ipairs(weights) do
        sum=sum+w
        if target < sum then return i end
    end
    return last
end
return choose

tasks.goal: Advance an explicit deterministic PRNG state
tasks.prompt: Write a pure Luau module returning the requested function. Use only numbers, plain tables and the standard library; no Roblox engine objects, services, global state, clock or global RNG. Inputs are finite numbers of moderate magnitude unless an invalid-input case is specified. Do not mutate input tables. Return nextRandom(state) -> nextState,u. Require integer state in [1,2147483646]. Use nextState=(state*16807)%2147483647 and u=(nextState-1)/2147483646 in [0,1). Reject invalid states. Keep state explicit: no closure state, math.random or math.randomseed. This is a reproducible gameplay stream, not cryptography or an emulation of Roblox Random. Numerical answers use absolute tolerance 1e-9 and relative tolerance 0; booleans, nil, indices and integer states are exact.

local function nextRandom(state)
    assert(type(state) == "number" and state >= 1 and state <= 2147483646 and state == math.floor(state), "state")
    local nextState=(state*16807)%2147483647
    return nextState,(nextState-1)/2147483646

return nextRandom

tasks.goal: Accumulate fixed steps without silently losing time
tasks.prompt: Write a pure Luau module returning the requested function. Use only numbers, plain tables and the standard library; no Roblox engine objects, services, global state, clock or global RNG. Inputs are finite numbers of moderate magnitude unless an invalid-input case is specified. Do not mutate input tables. Return advance(accumulator,dt,step,maxSteps) -> count,remainder,alpha. Require finite accumulator>=0, dt>=0, step>0 and integer maxSteps>=0. count=min(floor((accumulator+dt)/step),maxSteps); remainder=accumulator+dt-count*step; alpha=min(remainder/step,1). Preserve backlog even if it exceeds a step; do not discard it at the cap. Tests use binary-exact step sizes at boundaries. Numerical answers use absolute tolerance 1e-9 and relative tolerance 0; booleans, nil, indices and integer states are exact.

unit_test.body:
local f = load_answer()
local function near(a, b)
    return type(a) == "number" and math.abs(a - b) <= 1e-9
end
check("returns a function", type(f) == "function")
local n,r,a=f(0,0.0625,0.125,4)
check("partial step", n == 0 and near(r,0.0625) and near(a,0.5))
n,r,a=f(0.0625,0.0625,0.125,4)
check("exact boundary", n == 1 and near(r,0) and near(a,0))
n,r,a=f(0.0625,0.25,0.125,4)
check("multiple steps with remainder", n == 2 and near(r,0.0625) and near(a,0.5))
n,r,a=f(0,1,0.125,3)
check("cap preserves backlog", n == 3 and near(r,0.625) and near(a,1))
local n2,r2,a2=f(r,0,0.125,8)
check("later call catches up", n2 == 5 and near(r2,0) and near(a2,0))
n,r,a=f(0.0625,0.25,0.125,0)
check("zero cap preserves all time", n == 0 and near(r,0.3125) and near(a,1))
check("negative time rejected", not pcall(f,-1,0,0.125,4) and not pcall(f,0,-1,0.125,4))
check("invalid step rejected", not pcall(f,0,1,0,4) and not pcall(f,0,1,-1,4))
check("invalid cap rejected", not pcall(f,0,1,0.125,-1) and not pcall(f,0,1,0.125,1.5))
check("nonfinite input rejected", not pcall(f,0,math.huge,0.125,4) and not pcall(f,0,0,0/0,4))

tasks.reference_answer:
local function advance(accumulator,dt,step,maxSteps)
    assert(accumulator >= 0 and accumulator < math.huge and dt >= 0 and dt < math.huge, "time")
    assert(step > 0 and step < math.huge, "step")
    assert(maxSteps >= 0 and maxSteps < math.huge and maxSteps == math.floor(maxSteps), "maxSteps")
    local total=accumulator+dt
    assert(total < math.huge, "total")
    local count=math.min(math.floor(total/step),maxSteps)
    local remainder=total-count*step
    return count,remainder,math.min(remainder/step,1)
end
return advance
